name: normal-samples-state
source:
import statistics, random
random.seed(123)
d=statistics.NormalDist()
before=random.getstate()
a=d.samples(4)
print(before == random.getstate())
b=d.samples(4)
print(a == b)
random.seed(123)
print(a == d.samples(4))
random.seed(456)
print(a == d.samples(4))

name: normal-samples-explicit-seed-control
source:
import statistics,random
random.seed(123)
d=statistics.NormalDist()
before=random.getstate()
a=d.samples(4,seed=42)
b=d.samples(4,seed=42)
print(a==b)
print(before==random.getstate())
print(len(a),all(isinstance(x,float) for x in a))

name: normal-seed-shapes
source:
import statistics,random
n=statistics.NormalDist()
for seed in ['hello',b'hello',2**80,1.5,False]:
 a=n.samples(3,seed=seed)
 print(a==n.samples(3,seed=seed))
print(n.samples(-1))

name: normal-interleaves-shared-generator
source:
import statistics,random
d=statistics.NormalDist(2,3)
random.seed(42)
a=d.samples(4)
random.seed(42)
random.random()
b=d.samples(4)
print(a==b)
try:d.samples(1,42)
